cloud_mod1.title: Level 0: S3 Public Access & Policy Hardening
cloud_mod1.mission: A rogue contractor left a storage bucket publicly accessible. Enumerate public S3 buckets anonymously, retrieve unencrypted audit logs, and reconfigure S3 Block Public Access & Bucket Policies.

cloud_mod2.title: Level 1: IAM Inline Policy Audit & Role Delegation
cloud_mod2.mission: Investigate developer account permissions. Locate an overly permissive IAM role allowing sts:AssumeRole without external ID verification, assume the DevOps role, and fix the trust policy.

cloud_mod3.title: Level 2: EC2 SSRF & IMDSv2 Hardening
cloud_mod3.mission: A web application on an EC2 instance suffers from SSRF. Exploit the SSRF to query legacy IMDSv1, then harden the EC2 instance by enforcing IMDSv2 (HttpTokens: required).

cloud_mod4.title: Level 3: Lambda, SSM & Secrets Manager Hardening
cloud_mod4.mission: Analyze a serverless Lambda order processor leaking environment variables. Retrieve master DB passwords from AWS Secrets Manager and KMS re-encrypt the secret using a Customer-Managed Key.

cloud_mod5.title: Level 4: Forensic Log Analysis & Key Revocation
cloud_mod5.mission: Investigate CloudTrail event logs to trace unauthorized user creation overnight. Identify the compromised developer access key, deactivate the key, and delete the backdoor IAM user.

cloud_mod6.title: Level 5: Capstone: Account Governance & SCP Guardrails
cloud_mod6.mission: Perform a final platform compliance audit for CloudCorp CISO. Attach an account governance boundary enforcing region ap-south-1 and complete the master Cloud Security certification.
